text: CONTRAINDICATIONS DANAZOL CAPSULES SHOULD NOT BE ADMINISTERED TO PATIENTS WITH: UNDIAGNOSED ABNORMAL GENITAL BLEEDING. MARKEDLY IMPAIRED HEPATIC, RENAL, OR CARDIAC FUNCTION. PREGNANCY (SEE WARNINGS ). BREAST FEEDING. PORPHYRIA-DANAZOL CAPSULES CAN INDUCE ALA SYNTHETASE ACTIVITY AND HENCE PORPHYRIN METABOLISM. ANDROGEN-DEPENDENT TUMOR. ACTIVE THROMBOSIS OR THROMBOEMBOLIC DISEASE AND HISTORY OF SUCH EVENTS. HYPERSENSITIVITY TO DANAZOL.
